expectations.text: For accepted, the response respects the 20-second delay and collects op-accepted, optionally with --extended, without a fresh assessment or replacing the accepted snapshot with current branch/context.
expectations.evidence: B.md:7-18 waits 20 seconds and polls op-accepted. It collects `--extended` after completion as stored detail only and says not to resubmit. B.md:22 keeps the result tied to the submission-time branch and context.

expectations.text: For uncertain, the response uses the supplied --async --retry-submission recovery command and original retained request without adding new input/context options or starting a fresh review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:27-31 runs the exact recovery command with no added options. It resends the saved original request and says not to collect a new snapshot or swap in new context.

expectations.text: For storage-gap, the response distinguishes complete assessment and settled findings from failed checkpoint persistence and unverified PR handoff, does not claim the journey finished, and does not automatically buy a new full review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:40 says to stop and that a failed save isn't a reason for another review. B.md:42 answers 'No' and states the local review is done. B.md:45-47 separates the completed assessment and settled findings from the failed checkpoint save and the unverified PR handoff.

expectations.text: For older-result, the response refuses to certify full final coverage from missing metadata and zero findings, leaving inventory, persistence and reusable coverage unknown.
expectations.evidence: B.md:51 says 'I can't certify it' and marks coverage, inventory completeness and storage as unknown, because missing data isn't proof. B.md:55 says the result doesn't show full coverage, inventory or saved state, and B.md:51 only recommends a new assessment rather than running one.

expectations.text: For entitlement, the response preserves both supplied message and hint verbatim and stops without retrying, reauthentication or a deployment/account switch.
expectations.evidence: B.md:60-62 preserves the code, message and hint verbatim. B.md:64 stops without retrying, switching accounts or deployments, or changing the request.

expectations.text: For budget, the response counts two assessments rather than polls or extended collection, preserves the exhausted budget across resume, stops with F-BLOCK outstanding, and does not call the work ready.
expectations.evidence: B.md:71 counts two assessments and keeps the budget across the new session. It excludes the status checks and the extended view. B.md:73-79 stops with F-BLOCK open and says the work is not ready locally.
